definition_zh: 根据影像恢复或测量对象几何信息的技术。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

usage_variants.context_label: 监测与数字化 · Digital Railway Infrastructure（2024）

complete_examples.text: The classic solutions known from photogrammetry is based on observing the stationary target and subtracting the displacement of the stationary object from the displacements of the moving bridge targets—Olaszek [5], Luo et al. [6].

Using photogrammetry and converting UAV-taken images into a photorealistic 3D model of a bridge, inspectors can perform a visual structural evaluation on a computer, without subjectiveness arising in how the data has been documented.
